definition: A differential equation whose highest derivative is a second derivative, such as $\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}x}{\mathrm{d}t^{2}} = f\left(x, \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t}, t\right)$; putting $y = \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t}$ turns it into the coupled first-order equations $\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t} = y$ and $\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t} = f(x, y, t)$.
